description: Our own base images, ghcr.io/foreverworks/debian and ghcr.io/foreverworks/node, which foreverworks/debian-oci-images releases within about an hour of a Debian security snapshot that changes them.

Owner's decision, 2026-11-22 (FLEET-100): in infra, job-crm, mcps and finledger, Renovate merges these two images' digest bumps, and tag bumps within the same line, on green CI. Every other update stays a PR the owner merges.

Renovate merges only when every check on its branch has passed: a branch with no checks waits, and one red check stops the merge. Where a repo allows GitHub's auto-merge, its required checks hold the merge too.

packageRules.description: Every FROM line on these images stays pinned by digest, so each new release is a change Renovate can see.
A new base merges on its own once CI is green, at any hour, because it usually carries a security fix. A new major line (Debian 14, the next Node LTS) is not covered: it stays a PR.
prBodyNotes: A new release of our own base image (foreverworks/debian-oci-images). Renovate merges this PR once every check on it has passed (owner, 2026-11-22, FLEET-100). A red check stops it here for a person to look at.
